description: The verdict policy of trendcourt/thresholds.json as it will be applied, on trend-free monthly series (seasonal cycle + stationary AR(1) noise): each replicate goes through trendcourt.benchmark.run_case (clerk.deseasonalize, examiner.theil_sen, examiner.mk_hamed_rao lag=3; no seasonal test) and is put in a band by its own r1_detrended (thresholds.significance_claim). 'false_claim': any significance claim (Moderate or Strong) the band allows; 'false_strong': p < alpha_strong in a band that allows Strong. 'widened_coverage': the Theil-Sen interval widened with the replicate's own r1 (thresholds.widened_interval) contains 0; 'widened_coverage_true_phi': widened with the factor at the true phi.

series.sigma_meaning: stationary standard deviation of the AR(1) noise
